title: Particle Dynamics of Flow Matching and Classifier-Free Guidance from a Stagewise Geometry Perspective
abstract: arXiv:2609.06947v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Flow matching, together with classifier-free guidance (CFG), is widely used in generative modeling, yet much of the theoretical understanding remains distribution-wise. Since practical sampling follows individual trajectories, distribution-level guarantees alone do not fully capture how trajectories interact with the data geometry or how guidance reshapes it. To overcome this limitation, we establish a unified stagewise geometric theory of attraction and absorption for both continuous dynamics and explicit Euler discretization. Specifically, with $t\in[0,1]$ running from noise to data, we show that unconditional flow trajectories are successively attracted toward a neighborhood of the global mean, the data convex hull, and a neighborhood of a possibly nonconvex local cluster. Across these stages, the corresponding distance satisfies a common contraction estimate, yielding an ${O}(1-t)$ decay of the distance in the final stage. For CFG, t

translated_title: 从分阶段几何视角解析流匹配与无分类器引导的粒子动力学
translated_abstract: 流匹配与无分类器引导在生成建模中被广泛使用，然而其大部分理论理解仍停留在分布层面。由于实际采样遵循的是个体轨迹，仅有分布层面的保证无法充分刻画轨迹如何与数据几何相互作用，以及引导如何重塑数据几何。为克服这一局限，我们针对连续动力学和显式欧拉离散化，建立了一个统一的分阶段吸引与吸收几何理论。具体而言，当 t∈[0,1] 从噪声演化到数据时，我们证明无条件流轨迹会依次被吸引至全局均值的邻域、数据的凸包，以及一个可能非凸的局部聚类的邻域。在这些阶段中，相应的距离满足一个共同的收缩估计，使得在最后阶段距离以 O(1-t) 的速度衰减。对于 CFG，……
tldr: 该论文建立了流匹配与无分类器引导的统一分阶段几何理论，证明采样轨迹从噪声到数据会依次被吸引向全局均值邻域、数据凸包和局部聚类邻域，且各阶段均满足统一的收缩估计。
en_tdlr: This paper establishes a unified stagewise geometric theory for flow matching and classifier-free guidance, showing that sampling trajectories are successively attracted toward a neighborhood of the global mean, the data convex hull, and a local cluster, with a common contraction estimate across all stages.
